caption: The drawing contains two main objects, both colored predominantly in shades of blue with some red and black accents. The object at the top is an elongated, oval-shaped, metallic-looking item with a pale blue surface, darker outlines, and hints of rust or wear. It features two circular red fixtures along its central seam and two small, round holes with black edges. The object at the bottom appears to be a stylized representation of a paddle steamer boat. It is mostly light blue, with open rectangular windows along its sides and a large central paddle wheel outlined in black. There are two red smokestacks positioned towards the rear and middle of the boat, and a small round structure with a pointed red top on the upper deck towards the front. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Steamboat Coin Bank
